objective: Find a slow intraday UPRO/SPXU system that trades at least twice weekly, survives executable costs and delays, and grows a $100 cash account faster than passive SPY price appreciation.
lineage_warning: This family was designed after observing earlier price-pattern and pair-geometry failures. It is a new frozen batch but not statistically independent of the broader research program.

data.signal_bars: Databento ARCX.PILLAR UPRO/SPXU ohlcv-1m where required
data.execution: Databento ARCX.PILLAR UPRO/SPXU bbo-1m; EQUS.MINI audit for unlocked holdout

spy_hurdle.measurement: A fractional $100 passive SPY position from the first eligible 2021 09:30 open through the final eligible 2023 15:59 close for development, and the equivalent same-period measurement for later comparisons.
spy_hurdle.dividends: Databento OHLCV does not contain reinvested distributions. This is a price-only hurdle and is therefore easier than true SPY total return.
spy_hurdle.development_gate: The strategy's simulated cash-account ending equity must exceed the development SPY price-only ending value.
spy_hurdle.final_gate: Any unlocked five-year strategy account must exceed five-year passive SPY price appreciation before it can be considered useful.

shared_signal_clock.bbo_window: 09:31-11:00 inclusive, exactly 90 valid end-of-minute BBO states for quote-depth hypotheses
shared_signal_clock.bar_window: 09:30-10:59 inclusive; absent ARCA trade bars contribute zero activity and no price is fabricated
shared_signal_clock.latency: All features aggregate 90 minutes and must survive one-minute and five-minute delayed entries.

shared_execution.bullish_trade: Buy fractional UPRO at the observed ask
shared_execution.bearish_trade: Buy fractional SPXU at the observed ask
shared_execution.catastrophe_stop: A 3.333333% adverse SPY move from the 11:01 open, evaluated on completed bars and executed at the following ETF bid

definitions.quote_imbalance: (bid size - ask size) / (bid size + ask size)
definitions.displayed_notional_depth: quote price multiplied by displayed quote size
definitions.impedance: proportional spread divided by square root of bid-notional times ask-notional

hypotheses.claim: Because UPRO and SPXU express opposite exposure, simultaneous UPRO bid support and SPXU ask supply form a bullish book alignment; the reverse forms bearish alignment. Repeated reciprocal alignments reveal slow dealer inventory rather than one quote.
hypotheses.score: Count minutes with UPRO imbalance > 0 and SPXU imbalance < 0, then subtract minutes with SPXU imbalance > 0 and UPRO imbalance < 0.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign; skip zero.

hypotheses.claim: The change in displayed depth orientation from the first to last morning half-hour measures inventory migration. Differencing inverse funds removes market-wide quote-size expansion.
hypotheses.score: For each ETF, subtract median 09:31-10:00 imbalance from median 10:31-11:00 imbalance. Score equals UPRO migration minus SPXU migration.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign; skip zero.

hypotheses.claim: A one-sided book that retains its sign instead of flickering has memory. The inverse fund with stronger signed memory identifies the directional inventory state likely to persist.
hypotheses.score: For each ETF, multiply median quote imbalance by one minus its fraction of consecutive imbalance-sign changes. Score equals UPRO signed memory minus SPXU signed memory.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign; skip zero.

hypotheses.claim: Spread alone is incomplete; the same spread supported by deeper notional is lower impedance. The exposure whose impedance falls more from the first to last half-hour is becoming easier for dealers to warehouse.
hypotheses.score: For each ETF, divide median late-half-hour impedance by median early-half-hour impedance. Score equals the SPXU ratio minus the UPRO ratio, so positive means relatively greater UPRO impedance relief.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign; skip invalid values and zero.

hypotheses.claim: The first half-hour in which both inverse ETFs print on ARCA every minute is a participation synchronization event. Within that event, the side whose volume mass arrives later owns the freshest inventory.
hypotheses.score: Inspect 09:30-09:59, 10:00-10:29, and 10:30-10:59 in order. Use the first block with exactly 30 bars for both ETFs. Score equals UPRO volume-time centroid minus SPXU centroid within that block.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign at 11:01; skip days without a complete block or exact ties.

hypotheses.claim: The derivative of participation matters more than total participation. The ETF gaining active trading minutes in the second 45 minutes has accelerating attention.
hypotheses.score: For each ETF, subtract its number of observed ARCA trade minutes from 09:30-10:14 from its count from 10:15-10:59. Score equals UPRO acceleration minus SPXU acceleration.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign; skip ties.

hypotheses.claim: A fund receiving a larger fraction of its own morning volume late has fresher flow, even when its absolute activity is structurally different from the inverse fund.
hypotheses.score: For each ETF, calculate 10:15-10:59 volume divided by total 09:30-10:59 volume. Score equals the UPRO late share minus the SPXU late share.
hypotheses.direction: Trade the score sign; skip invalid values and ties.

development_gates.holdout_access: Only candidates passing every development gate may access 2024-2025.

prohibited_repairs: Select only UPRO or only SPXU after results.
Add quote-size, volume, score, clock, spread, year, or regime thresholds after results.
Claim victory against SPY total return using a price-only benchmark.
